product.name: Retail Banking Services
product.description: Provides banking services to individual customers including savings, checking accounts, and personal loans.

product.name: Corporate Banking Services
product.description: Offers financial products and credit facilities tailored for businesses and corporate clients.

product.name: Investment Banking Services
product.description: Provides advisory and financing services for mergers, acquisitions, and capital raising.

product.name: Trade Finance Services
product.description: Facilitates international trade through letters of credit, guarantees, and export-import financing.

product.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
product.description: Manages liquidity, payments, and financial risk for corporate clients.
